android.desc:
Do you fall asleep in meetings, lectures, or church? You're not lazy. The speaker is boring.

FocusPulse fights back.

It sends random silent vibration alerts to your phone during any session. You tap “I’m Focused” when you feel it. Miss one? You were probably zoning out. That’s the whole point, it keeps your brain on edge, waiting for the next buzz.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Start a session (30, 60, 90 min or custom)
2. Your phone vibrates at unpredictable intervals
3. Tap “I’m Focused” within seconds
4. See your focus score, streaks, and trends

PERFECT FOR:
• Students in lectures and seminars
• Professionals in long meetings
• People with ADHD or attention challenges
• Anyone who wants to measure and improve their focus

KEY FEATURES:
• Session tracking (30/60/90 min or custom)
• Random, unpredictable vibration alerts (can’t be gamed)
• Focus score calculation with reaction time tracking
• Daily streaks and consistency gamification
• Trend graphs (7D / 30D / 90D)
• Session history and analytics
• Clean dark/light mode UI

WHY VIBRATION?
Visual apps are obvious. FocusPulse works silently in your pocket. Nobody in the meeting knows. That’s the point.

CURRENTLY FREE during early access. Premium features coming soon.

*Built cause I kept zoning out at Important meetings and Events
